title: A canned line's no-cost part keeps its saved price until its cost comes in
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new canned line for this test, canned line 1, with a special-order part in category A, no cost, saved price $150.00.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Add canned line 1 to work order 1.
  3. Point at the part's sell price.
  4. Click the part's description to open Edit Part Request.
  5. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  6. Click Save Part.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The part reads $150.00.

Step 3:

  • The details read "Saved price from canned line" with canned line 1's name, then "Priced by" tier A's name and "when its cost comes in."

Step 4:

  • Edit Part Request opens.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads 100.00.

Step 6:

  • The sell price becomes $121.50 ($135.00 × 0.90 = $121.50).
